_comment: Documents the keys this repo's scripts expect at runtime. Real values go in .env or config.json (both gitignored), not in this file -- see CLAUDE.md's 'Secrets never enter git' invariant. This file itself is checked into git as documentation only.
STRAVA_ACCESS_TOKEN: Short-lived OAuth access token, used by ingestion/strava/verify_activity_id_alignment.py (issue #16)
birth_date: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). Not a secret, but personal data -- goes in config.json (gitignored, local-only), never committed. Reserved for age-at-activity-date calculations (e.g. heart rate zone thresholds) -- captured ahead of that work, not yet consumed by any code.
